title: Nose Radome
label: SOURCED
summary: Pointed, chined composite nose cone covering the forward AESA radar antenna while maintaining a continuous low-observable mold line.
role: Protects the radar aperture aerodynamically while allowing radio-frequency transmission in the radar operating band (bandpass details classified).
